caption:
TRUE or FALSE? 🤔
"A big tax refund means you got free money."
Think before you answer.
Comment your guess, then check the first comment for the answer.
first_comment: Answer: FALSE. A refund is your own money that was over-withheld all year, returned with no interest. 👇 Did you know that?

instagram.first_comment: Refund = your own money back. Did you know? Tell @paychecktruths 👇
